meta_description:
22K likes, 1,193 comments - ishitamangal on February 12, 2026: "Comment “IMLIPS” to get a link of all products 

I’m always testing lip colours because brown skin doesn’t get the luxury of “any shade will do.” Some colours turn grey. Some go neon. Some look stunning in the tube and completely disappear on melanin. So when I find lip shades that actually work, I want to show them to you. 

These lip colours are brown skin friendly because the undertones are right, the pigment is balanced, and the formulas don’t fight your natural lip colour. They don’t need fixing with liner. They don’t wash you out. They just sit well on brown skin.

And good formulas matter. If a lipstick is cracking, drying, or vanishing in two hours, the shade doesn’t matter. These feel comfortable, wear well, and look good in real life not just under studio lights.

This isn’t about hyping products. It’s about saving brown girls from trial and error fatigue. Inmein se koi shade tum par weird nahi lagega. This is my #IMSold waada to you! Enjoy! 👄 

#makeuptutorial #makeupgirl #lipsticks".
